Auth (steps 2–4, 12): Device never makes auth decisions — the host does.
Interlock (steps 5–9): Hatch latch S3 never opens during a dispense.
Host converts raw counts → grams with stored calibration (offset, scale).
Fig 11 — Sequence: controlled-substance dispense (2FA + witnessed waste)
PIN + badge on the host, DISPENSE 6 checked by a 12 g weight drop, a required vial-tag check, and a witnessed waste record.
